description: Official .NET client for pushq, a self-hosted HTTP push task queue (an open-source alternative to Google Cloud Tasks). Create queues with rate limits and retries, enqueue HTTP tasks, and verify signed deliveries.

Read-only JSON and MCP endpoints over relational data for ASP.NET Core apps: list, describe and query catalogued sources with row caps and validated queries. Bring a database engine: derive DatabaseEngine<TConnection> from DataGateway.Data for any ADO.NET database.
DataGateway's catalog model, query validation and error contract. Brought in by DataGateway; no database dependency.
DataGateway's catalog reader and database engine base classes. Derive DatabaseEngine<TConnection> to add any ADO.NET database.
DataGateway's PostgreSQL engine (Npgsql). Register it with AddEngine to serve catalogued PostgreSQL sources.
DataGateway's Snowflake engine. Register it with AddEngine to serve catalogued Snowflake sources.
DataGateway's SQL Server engine (Microsoft.Data.SqlClient). Register it with AddEngine to serve catalogued SQL Server sources.
Spell out numbers in Bangla: words, currency (taka/paisa), ordinals, years and dates. Zero dependencies.
Convert Typst documents to editable Word (.docx) files.

Opt-in MSBuild post-publish integration that orchestrates the NetPublishOptimizer command-line tool. Optimization is disabled unless NetPublishOptimizerEnabled is true.
Command-line optimizer and validator for already-published .NET application directories. Python-free; no trace or diagnostics dependencies.
